title: alumis eyes late stage lupus study despite trial miss 2026 09 01
text:
Sept 1 (Reuters) - Alumis (ALMS.O)
, opens new tab
 said on Tuesday it plans to advance its experimental drug for a type of immunity-related condition in ​a smaller subset of patients, even after the treatment failed ‌to meet the main goal of a mid-stage trial.
Its shares slumped more than 55% in premarket trading, as Wall Street had viewed the study as an important ​test in a disease long seen as a drug-development graveyard.
